item.title: U.S. influence in Latin America at stake in runoff election in Brazil
item.description: A polarizing presidential election runoff in Latin America's largest economy and biggest democracy pits leftist Lula da Silva's legacy against Trump ally Flavio Bolsonaro, son of the former Brazilian president.
item.content:encoded: A polarizing presidential election runoff in Latin America's largest economy and biggest democracy pits leftist Lula da Silva's legacy against Trump ally Flavio Bolsonaro, son of the former Brazilian president.
item.dc:creator: Carrie Kahn

item.title: This center-right former general could unseat Netanyahu as Prime Minister in Israel
item.description: A former Israeli general is the main center-right challenger hoping to unseat Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in Israeli elections this week.

item.title: Israelis have changed. Will they change their leadership?
item.description: Israel is holding a general election this week after years of war. For many Israelis, shaken by the Oct. 7, 2023, attacks and years of war, it is the most consequential in decades.

item.title: This College of Magic turns ordinary kids into cool magicians
item.description: The students, many from marginalized communities, learn to conjure up candy, do card tricks — and face the world with a confident, creative and resilient mindset.

item.title: Soldiers guard center of Milan as thousands of protesters march in cities across Europe
item.description: While protests in France have claimed most international attention, large demonstrations also rocked many European cities Saturday from Milan to Rome to Madrid, Lisbon and Tirana.

item.title: Protests roil France once again as police seek to quell violence
item.description: Hundreds of thousands turned out across France to protest everything from the lack of school funding to economic inequality. Police also were out in force to prevent a repeat of last week's violence.

item.title: Why a far-right cabinet minister in Israel has Netanyahu's ear
item.description: Israel's most far-right cabinet minister helped dictate hardline policies toward Palestinians in recent years. Benjamin Netanyahu vows to give him a senior position if Netanyahu is reelected next week.

item.title: Musk says SpaceX did restrict Starlink, as Ukraine says the tech has been restored
item.description: Musk said Ukraine had been violating Starlink's terms by using it for military activity, as Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said normal operating speeds have returned.
